POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.

2. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.

7. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

8. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

9. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

12. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle Chassis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body joining processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
